# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Formulas instead of values | 37378, 46897 | Agent writes Excel formulas which the grader cannot read | KNOWLEDGE | Output Contract |
| 2 | Empty cells / Missing values | 227-40, 48527, 50768 | Agent misses cells in range or writes empty strings | BEHAVIORAL | Ordered Procedure |
| 3 | Excel Error Strings | 37456 | Agent writes #N/A or other error strings | KNOWLEDGE | Output Contract |
| 4 | Value Mismatches | 267-18, 39046, 43436, 51-12 | Logic errors in computation | CAPABILITY-GAP | Method/Procedure |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Formulas | Tighten Contract | prompt.md | Explicit "Literal Values ONLY" rule. Generalizes to all tasks. | Yes |
| Empty Cells | Ordered Procedure | prompt.md | 6-step "Operational Procedure" making verification unavoidable. | Yes |
| Error Strings | Tighten Contract | prompt.md | "No Error Strings" rule. Prevents writing #N/A. | Yes |
| General | Role/Goal | prompt.md | Defined agent as expert Python dev specializing in pandas/openpyxl. | Yes |
| All | Contract Reinforcement | task_template.md | Explicit requirements for literal values and targeted modification. | Yes |

## Verify-the-fix
- 37378, 46897: wrote formula → now strictly forbidden in prompt and template.
- 227-40, 48527: missing values → ordered procedure requires "Verify" step before saving.
- 37456: wrote error string → "No Error Strings" rule explicitly forbids this.
- 51-12, 267-18: logic errors → defined role and operational procedure encourages better analysis/verification.

## Process & features used
- Serial fallback for initial capability creation.
- Analysis of trajectories for the 4 main failure clusters.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The strict "Literal Values" requirement (crucial for the grader).
- The "Operational Procedure" structure.

## Deliberately skipped
- No clusters skipped; all addressed by the general prompt and template.
